title: Tropical Thunder (Hurricane Variant)
tags: rum tiki sour tropical citrus passion-fruit overproof-rum shaken OFTD
content: Tropical Thunder (Hurricane Variant) summary A rich, full strength Hurricane built from the Minimalist Tiki recipe. Bright lemon and passion fruit provide tart tropical flavors, while vanilla syrup and allspice dram add warmth and baking spice notes. Plantation O.F.T.D. delivers a bold, overproof rum backbone with deep molasses and funky Jamaican character. glassware 16 oz mason jar or Hurricane glass (if using the latter, will need to double the recipe) ingredients 2 oz overproof rum 1 oz lemon juice scant .75 oz passion fruit syrup .375 oz vanilla syrup .375 oz allspice dram garnish Lemon wheel Edible flower (optional) Mint sprig (optional) equipment Jigger Mixing tin Flash blender instructions 1. Add all ingredients to a mixing tin. 1. Fill with 8 oz crushed ice and flash blend 5 10 seconds. 1. Pour into glass, add crushed ice to fill. 1. Garnish and serve. recommended brands Rum: Plantation O.F.T.D. Passion fruit syrup: Liber & Co. Vanilla syrup: Portland Syrups Allspice dram: St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram notes Fresh lemon juice is strongly recommended. For a slightly less intense drink, split the rum base with 2 oz O.F.T.D. and 2 oz aged Jamaican or Demerara rum. Crushed ice provides the most authentic tiki presentation and dilution. tags rum, tiki, sour, tropical, citrus, passion fruit, overproof rum, shaken, OFTD
